attempts.summary: On node1 (Ubuntu 16.04 xenial, i386), built a local apt repository at /srv/localrepo from downloaded .deb files (target package cowsay + cowsay-off), served it via python3 http.server on $NODE_IP:8080, blocked the remote Ubuntu mirrors via /etc/hosts and pointed apt sources solely at the local repo, then successfully installed cowsay entirely from local storage while remote repos returned connection-refused. Restored normal apt/hosts config afterward. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured boot_id baseline, restarted via shutdown -r now, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified recovered state (cowsay still installed and functional, local repo files intact, apt sources back to remote config, remote mirror reachable again).
